usage: A 衣架 (ji1 gaa3) is a noun used to describe a clothes hanger, an object used for hanging clothes.
In sentences, 衣架 usually functions as a subject or an object, referring to the physical hanger.
You can use 衣架 to talk about storing clothes or drying them after washing.
When modifying 衣架, you can add adjectives like '木製' (wooden) or '膠製' (plastic) to describe the material.
Clothing verbs like 掛 (gwaa3 - hang) or 收拾 (sau1 sap6 - tidy up) often appear with 衣架.
